sections.heading: Your voice. Your AI. Across India.

blocks.x: Akaya is a voice-first personal AI assistant built for how India actually uses phones: Android first, mobile data that comes and goes, and a to-do list that lives inside chat apps. Speak once, and Akaya understands, decides, and acts.

sections.heading: What Indian users ask Akaya to do

blocks.x: Phone Agent for everyday Android use
Speak, and Akaya reads what is on screen, drafts your message, and carries out routine phone actions with a confirmation step before anything sensitive runs.
Job hunting in Bengaluru, Pune and Delhi NCR
Set role, city, experience and expected pay, and the Job Search Agent ranks matches on skills fit, location and total compensation.
The Shopping Agent compares products, prices, ratings, reviews and specifications from supported sources so a buying decision takes minutes.
Organise expenses, recurring bills and savings goals in INR. Akaya explains what your money is doing; it does not provide regulated financial advice.
On-device commands keep working in metros, lifts, trains and low-signal areas, then hand back to full online intelligence when data returns.
Voice first, typing when you need it
Talk to Akaya in plain Indian English. In a quiet office or a noisy street, the same assistant accepts typed input with identical results.
Yes. Akaya runs on Android and iOS anywhere in India, and the browser assistant works on any modern mobile data or broadband connection. Windows and Mac apps are still coming soon.
Does the AI assistant work without internet in India?

Offline mode runs entirely on the device, so timers, reminders, notes, unit conversions, time checks and quick maths keep working in metros with weak indoor signal, on trains, in lifts and in low-coverage rural areas. Full understanding and spoken replies resume the moment data returns.
Which languages does Akaya support for Indian users?
Akaya currently understands and replies in English, including Indian English phrasing. Hindi and other Indian languages are not supported yet.
Can Akaya show amounts in rupees?
When you ask in rupees, Akaya keeps amounts in INR and uses Indian conventions such as lakh and crore for large figures.
Does Akaya use a lot of mobile data?
Online requests are short text exchanges rather than continuous streaming, and offline commands use no data at all, so day-to-day use stays light on a typical Indian mobile plan.
Can Akaya help with a job search in India?

The Job Search Agent searches, filters, matches and ranks roles by skills, experience, city and pay expectations, and works the same way for Indian cities such as Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and Chennai. Salary examples shown on the product page use USD.
